about: Deaths-and-errors telemetry (Dom 2026-10-28: 'tracking deaths and errors on a server'). The page (src/telemetry.ts) batches a few anonymous events and POSTs them to the SAME-ORIGIN `path` (nginx proxies /t to the collector on 127.0.0.1:`port`, deploy/telemetry/); the collector (server/telemetry/, node, NOT in the game bundle) validates every event against the `events` table below and appends one JSON line per event to a size-capped, rotating log. Privacy: a random per-browser id (localStorage, try/catch) and a random per-visit id; no IP is read or stored, no free text from the player (the only strings are the boss kind, an error message / stack from the code, and the build sha); `?telemetry=off`, Do-Not-Track, localhost and a non-sha dev build send nothing. Every number is a row here so the page and the collector cannot disagree.

session_start.about: the page became ready (once per visit)

session_end.about: the page was hidden or closed (sendBeacon); sec = seconds since the visit began, the last one per visit (sid) is the length

boss_death.about: a boss killed the hero. boss = the spawn's kind, sec = seconds engaged in this fight, heroHp / bossHp = percent of max left (the hero is 0)

boss_kill.about: the hero killed a boss. Same fields; bossHp is 0, heroHp is what the hero had left

clip_shared.about: the player sent a Share clip file to the share sheet or downloaded it (src/share-clip.ts). boss = the boss kind, sec = the clip's length in seconds (0 for a still picture). Nothing about the file or the player.

js_error.about: window.onerror, unhandledrejection, or a caught error routed through captureException (src/stubs.ts). kind: error | rejection | caught
